title: Extend the SharePoint user interface with SharePoint Framework extensions
shortDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) extensions that customize modern SharePoint pages and lists: an application customizer, a field customizer, and a command set.
longDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) extensions that customize modern SharePoint pages and lists: an application customizer, a field customizer, and a command set.
This tutorial contains the completed code for the exercises in the Microsoft Learn module Extend the SharePoint user interface with SharePoint Framework extensions.

references.name: Overview of the SharePoint Framework
references.description: The SharePoint Framework (SPFx) is a page and web part model that provides full support for client-side SharePoint development, easy integration with SharePoint data, and extending Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.
